reason: The README clearly describes a DeepSeek Harness plugin whose primary purpose is resilient multi-agent orchestration with model fallback, configurable execution modes, monitoring, and resumable run records.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供模型故障回退、多种子智能体编排模式、运行监控与中断恢复能力。
summaries.en: Provides DeepSeek Harness with model-failure fallback, configurable multi-agent orchestration modes, run monitoring, and resumable execution.

capabilities: Automatically retries failed model calls using configured fallback models
Orchestrates parallel, staged, routed, mapped, and supervised subagent tasks
Persists configuration, run history, task outputs, and resumable execution records
Registers slash commands and a user-invokable orchestration skill
